subject.title: [Bug]: /hooks/agent silently drops accountId — hook dispatch bypasses cron normalization pipeline

question: Should maintainers wait for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/43951 to be refreshed and proven, or replace it with a credited current-main fix for the still-open hook `accountId` bug?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible and the fix direction is clear, but the existing candidate PR is conflicting and lacks real multi-account delivery proof, which issue-lane automation should not bypass.

options.title: Replace on current main
options.body: Open or sponsor a narrow credited replacement PR that ports the fix to current `SourceDeliveryPlan` behavior, updates docs, and supplies maintainer-owned real delivery proof.

options.title: Wait for contributor refresh
options.body: Leave the issue paired with the open PR while the author rebases, resolves review feedback, and adds redacted real behavior proof.

options.title: Keep blocked without new work
options.body: Keep this issue open but do not start a new fix until a maintainer or contributor can provide a clean branch and proof.

recommendation.title: Replace on current main
recommendation.body: Open or sponsor a narrow credited replacement PR that ports the fix to current `SourceDeliveryPlan` behavior, updates docs, and supplies maintainer-owned real delivery proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest current gateway hook routing candidate from recent history and was explicitly requested for review on the linked PR.
